title: Put policy around the agent loop
description: Inject a realistic failure, choose a control profile, and decide whether retries preserve the business invariant.

policies.label: Permissive loop
policies.detail: Expose every tool and execute valid-looking calls immediately.

policies.label: Bounded loop
policies.detail: Validate schemas, restrict tools, and cap model and tool calls.

policies.label: Approval boundary
policies.detail: Add human review, idempotency, and outcome reconciliation around writes.

policies.label: Sensitive-data boundary
policies.detail: Redact protected values and retain metadata-only traces.

incidents.label: Refund response is lost
incidents.detail: The payment service may have committed the write before the connection closed.
incidents.safeResult: Reconcile the operation key before deciding whether another write is legal.
incidents.unsafeResult: A blind retry can issue a second refund because transport failure does not prove rollback.

incidents.label: Retrieved text requests a tool call
incidents.detail: An untrusted document tells the model to export customer records.
incidents.safeResult: Treat retrieved instructions as data and require policy approval for the requested action.
incidents.unsafeResult: The agent confuses retrieved content with authority and can invoke an unrelated privileged tool.

incidents.label: Search loop does not converge
incidents.detail: The model repeatedly calls search without improving its answer.
incidents.safeResult: Stop at the configured call budget and return an explicit incomplete outcome.
incidents.unsafeResult: Retries multiply latency and spend while the trajectory remains unchanged.

incidents.label: Sensitive data reaches traces
incidents.detail: A tool result includes an email address and payment identifier.
incidents.safeResult: Redact protected values before export and keep only operational metadata required for diagnosis.
incidents.unsafeResult: Useful observability becomes an uncontrolled secondary store for customer data.
